Both subtract from line 31 the deductible part of self-employment tax, the SEP or SIMPLE deduction and the health insurance deduction attributable to the business (i8995 p. 2; amb.2025.qbi_attribution). The second uses Form 7206 lines 7, 9 and 14 for the first two; the project's sc.qbi_se and sc.qbi_plan prorate the same amounts by the same ratio (net profit over person.positive_profits, which is Form 7206 line 5), so the comparison sees references on one side and their expansion on the other.

Ruling: owner's ruling; project retained. With one Schedule C both take the return's line 12. With more than one, the owner ruled that each business deducts its own 2025 elections when line 12 equals them (no allocation needed) and more than one Schedule C is refused otherwise; the second gives each business the whole line 12 and relies on s179.multi.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent within scope; project retained. Form 4562 line 22 for the business (line 12, lines 14 to 17, line 19 column (g), line 21) on both sides; the difference is the second's more-than-50% filter inside line 21. Listed property used 50% or less (Form 4562 line 27) is refused on both the asset and the vehicle (asset.yaml, scveh.yaml), so the second's filter for more than 50% business use selects the same entries within scope.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project's choose has one alternative whose guard (line 31 at least zero, or less than zero) always holds; it is line 31 on both sides. The choose carries the refusals that reach this line (statutory employee income, box 32b, and the others on sc.result). Both then floor at zero (Form 7206 line 4, net profit).

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. $5 times the smaller of the square footage and 300 (i1040sc Simplified Method Worksheet); the project chooses by an interval on the footage, the second takes the smaller of the two counts.
